newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia test-fires SS-24 ballistic missile.
newsitem.headline: Russia test-fires SS-24 ballistic missile.

text.p: Russia conducted a successful test firing of an SS-24 intercontinental ballistic missile from its northern cosmodrome at Plesetsk on Thursday, a spokesman for the strategic missile command said.
"We launched an SS-24 missile at 2.10 p.m. (1110 GMT) from the rail-based complex at Plesetsk near Arkhangelsk," he told Reuters by telephone.
The rocket's 10 warheads, which can carry nuclear charges, all hit targets on the Kamchatka peninsula in the Far East.
The spokesman said it was the fifth launch this year of an SS-24, codenamed "Scalpel". All have been successful.
